resources.string: Spyro\'s Adventure

This app contains no part of the game. Pick your own Xbox 360 disc image of Skylanders: Spyro\'s Adventure (an .iso file, about 7.5 GB); its files are copied into the app once. Afterwards you can delete the ISO.

The app comes with a tested driver (Mesa Turnip T30). Other Turnip builds can be imported here and picked in the game: Menu → Grafik → Grafiktreiber → Eigener. Only T30 has been tested.
